title: Structural Genomics vs Functional Genomics: A Comprehensive Guide for Research and Drug Development
description: A detailed comparison between structural genomics, which focuses on determining the three-dimensional structures of proteins, and functional genomics, which investigates the dynamic functions and interactions of genes. The article explores their principles, high-throughput methodologies, applications in biomedicine and agriculture, and challenges, offering a strategic framework for optimizing genomic approaches in therapeutic development.
